text:
samantha: Quick follow-up from the GPU-capacity postmortem: we need concrete owners for quota, scheduler tuning, and headroom work + short success metrics. Posting the table here so it's explicit.

samantha: Owners? timelines? metrics? rollback gates?

devin: I'll take quota cleanup + fast-path process. Plan: inventory all reserved GPU allocations, identify unused reservations older than 14 days, reclaim, and open cloud quota ticket for prod burst by 2026-04-01. Metric: reduce queued scheduling backlog >90s by 75% within 7 days post-change. Rollback: reassign reclaimed reservations if errors spike.

lee: I'll own scheduler adjustments (scheduling plugin weights + preempt thresholds). Reproduce hotspot in perf lab, tune scoring, and land config PR by 2026-03-30. Canary for 100 nodes 2026-04-03. Metric: scheduling p95 <350ms and p99 reduced by 40% vs baseline. Rollback: revert config if pod startup failures >0.3% in canary.

priya: Headroom/runbook updates here. Proposal: formalize headroom targets per cluster profile (dev=8%, staging=10%, prod=12%) and add auto-bump policy: if scheduler saturation >85% for 10m, add temporary capacity. Draft runbook + alert split by 2026-03-28. Metric: zero capacity-triggered fallbacks during peak windows for 4 weeks after rollout. Rollback: disable auto-bump if we see >20% wasted capacity for 24h.

samantha: Nice. Also saw repeated notes about slow node reprovision after evictions causing sustained pressure. Can we include a node reprovision speed task?

lee: Yep. I'll take node reprovision improvement: optimize init scripts, trim image size, and parallelize node-init. Target: reduce average node replacement time from ~9m to <4m by 2026-04-09. Metric: median node ready time <4m in staging. Rollback N/A (manual revert of image pipeline).

devin: Cloud approval lag has been painful. I'll set up a cloud-ops SLA for GPU quota requests and a fast-path escalation. Deliverable: contact list + runbook by 2026-03-29. Metric: quota emergency turnaround <48h for urgent requests.

samantha: Add small UX improvements: surface reserved-but-unused reservations in console and add owner tag. Who can do that?

priya: I can file a docs + console feature request with product; expected PR for console flag by 2026-04-06. Metric: 90% of reclaimed reservations have owner tags before reclaim.

samantha: Good. Please each add a single line in the incident tracker with owner, ETA, metric, and rollback. I'll create the ticket.

ops-bot: Created ticket INC-2026-4387 with subtasks: quota-cleanup (devin), scheduler-tuning (lee), headroom-runbook (priya), node-reprovision (lee), cloud-ops-sla (devin), console-flag (priya). Calendar invite: 2026-04-14 09:00 PT for follow-up sync. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-4387

devin: Starting the inventory now. Will post CSV of reservations and recommended reclaim list by EOD.

lee: Running scheduler lab tonight; will upload baseline telemetry and logs to the tracker tomorrow.

priya: Drafting runbook and alert splits, will share PR for review today.

samantha: Any immediate blockers we should escalate?

devin: Need org-level permission to reclaim some reservations. @samantha can you approve reclaim for these two reservations (res-4402, res-4471)?

samantha: Approved for res-4402 and res-4471. Add notes in the ticket when you reclaim them.

lee: No infra blockers but will need 2 hours of maintenance window for canary rollout on 2026-04-03.

priya: No blockers from docs side.

samantha: Great. Closing out this thread  please keep updates in the INC-2026-4387 tracker and ping this thread if anything unexpected pops up. :thumbsup:
